name: Thomas Jefferies Mann
headline: I build AI systems for credit and lending
summary: I started as an SBA credit specialist underwriting loans, then automated my way into building the bank's AI systems: LLM email triage for the lending inbox, competitor intelligence on SEC filings, and pipelines that draft credit memos with a human in the loop. I work between executives, developers and operations, turning what each of them needs into specs and working software.
focus: How people adopt (and misuse) AI tools

highlights: Internal AI consultant on a ground-up Loan Origination System rebuild, turning executive, developer and operations needs into specs.
Built an LLM email triage system for the Chief Lending Officer's inbox, which receives 1,000+ messages a day.
Built a competitor intelligence app on SEC filings with LangChain, FAISS, Gemini and RAG.
Advised executives on AI governance, leading to a company-wide policy restricting non-enterprise LLMs.
Led an intern team building LLM pipelines for automated credit memo drafting, with human-in-the-loop review.
Integrated OCR for tax document extraction in SBA loan workflows.
Automated loan portfolio changes and insight reporting.
Earlier: underwrote SBA 7(a) and 7(a) Small loans; managed reapprovals, change memos and commitment letters; automated document generation with VBA.
Streamlined risk acceptance and escalation workflows with VBA dashboards, reports and Tableau.
Built a product analyzer and demand forecast model in Python and VBA to assess competition, ease of rank and product profitability.

education.degree: Master in Business Analytics & Data Science
education.detail: Advanced AI specialization · ML, MLOps, NLP, Generative AI, Reinforcement Learning, Deep Learning, ML in the Cloud (AWS)

projects.name: DeepDiligence
projects.description: Streamlit app that pulls 10-K filings from SEC EDGAR, chunks and embeds them into a FAISS index, and answers natural-language questions with Gemini through LangChain. Compares filings from one company over time or across several companies.
projects.problem: Reading 10-Ks to compare competitors is slow, and keyword search misses the answer when the wording differs.

steps.title: Fetch
steps.text: Pull filing lists and documents for one or more companies from the SEC EDGAR API, validating CIKs.

steps.title: Chunk
steps.text: Clean the HTML and split each filing into overlapping text chunks.

steps.title: Embed
steps.text: Embed chunks with Gemini embeddings into a FAISS vector index, one index across all selected filings.

steps.title: Retrieve & answer
steps.text: For each question, retrieve the most relevant chunks and have Gemini answer through a LangChain QA chain, with sources shown.

projects.name: SEC Filing Analyzer
projects.tagline: API for parsing SEC filings and XBRL
projects.description: FastAPI backend that fetches 10-K and 10-Q filings, parses HTML sections and inline XBRL financial data, stores them in a database and processes filings in the background for AI analysis with Gemini.
projects.problem: Filings are long HTML documents with financial data buried in inline XBRL; analysis needs them structured first.

steps.title: Collect
steps.text: An SEC client fetches the latest 10-K and 10-Q filings for tracked companies.

steps.title: Parse
steps.text: Parsers extract HTML sections and inline XBRL financial facts, with chart standardisation.

steps.title: Store
steps.text: SQLAlchemy models store companies, filings and parsed sections.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: A FastAPI REST API exposes the data and runs parsing and Gemini analysis in the background.

projects.name: SBA FOIA Analyzer
projects.description: Command-line tool that loads public SBA 7(a) and 504 loan data, filters it by NAICS code or description, and produces summaries, state maps, time series, Excel output and PDF or Word reports.
projects.problem: Public SBA loan data is large and organised by NAICS code, which makes industry questions awkward to answer quickly.

steps.title: Load
steps.text: Pull 7(a) and 504 datasets straight from data.sba.gov.

steps.title: Filter
steps.text: Match by NAICS code prefix or search descriptions, optionally active loans only.

steps.title: Analyze
steps.text: Summary metrics plus state, regional, time-series and NAICS breakdowns.

steps.title: Report
steps.text: Interactive Plotly charts, Excel output, and PDF or Word reports.

projects.name: Equity Injection Tracker
projects.description: Concept app for loan officers and closing teams: a ledger of equity injection spending, invoices and bank statements attached to each line, sourced/unsourced totals, a drafted borrower email for missing documents, and a one-click closing-package PDF. Ships with generated demo data.
projects.problem: At SBA loan closing, every dollar of the borrower's equity injection has to be traced to invoices and bank statements, usually by hand.

steps.title: Ledger
steps.text: Track funds used, vendors, amounts and source accounts.

steps.title: Source
steps.text: Attach invoices and bank statements to each line and mark it sourced or unsourced, with running totals.

steps.title: Chase
steps.text: Request missing documents with a drafted borrower email.

steps.title: Package
steps.text: Export the whole closing package as one PDF, with an optional draft watermark.

projects.name: Ecolog-IA ESG Risk
projects.tagline: ESG scoring from IoT smart-grid data
projects.description: ESG risk dashboard built on IoT smart-grid data, with a Random Forest model, feature importance analysis, and a per-project assessment tool with recommendations.
projects.problem: ESG ratings are often opaque; this explores scoring projects from measured IoT smart-grid data instead.

steps.title: Ingest
steps.text: Process IoT smart-grid sensor data into project-level features.

steps.title: Model
steps.text: Train a Random Forest regressor and report feature importance and performance.

steps.title: Monitor
steps.text: Dashboard for risk classification across projects.

steps.title: Assess
steps.text: Score an individual project and suggest recommendations.

projects.name: Packaging Quality Prediction
projects.description: IE University capstone (team of five) for Capgemini × a fashion retailer. Trained Logistic Regression, Random Forest and XGBoost on 500,000+ packaging records; the XGBoost model reached AUC-ROC 0.701 with a tuned threshold, plus a cost-benefit calculator.
projects.problem: A fashion retailer's packaging failures were caught after shipment; the goal was to predict them before.

steps.title: Clean
steps.text: Merge and standardise four data sources, 500,000+ records.

steps.title: Engineer
steps.text: Build 28 features, including domain interactions like supplier × season.

steps.title: Model
steps.text: Compare Logistic Regression, Random Forest and XGBoost on imbalanced classes.

steps.title: Tune
steps.text: Optimise the decision threshold for business cost, with a cost-benefit calculator.

projects.name: Fashion-MNIST CNN
projects.description: Modular TensorFlow/Keras project with three CNN architectures, training reports and a prediction interface for outside images. The deep model's saved report shows 92.28% test accuracy.
projects.problem: A clean, modular deep learning codebase: train, compare and use CNNs end to end.

steps.title: Data
steps.text: Load and normalise Fashion-MNIST.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Three architectures: simple, deep and lightweight CNNs.

steps.title: Train
steps.text: Training with callbacks, saved models and written reports.

steps.title: Predict
steps.text: Preprocess outside images and classify them with a saved model.
